brief:
Israel prevented Shawan Jabarin, general director of the Palestinian human rights group Al-Haq, from travelling abroad by stopping him at the Allenby Bridge crossing on Friday, Middle East Eye reported. Jabarin was barred from proceeding to Jordan, effectively blocking his international travel.

Al-Haq has documented alleged Israeli violations in the occupied Palestinian territories. The travel restriction on its director marks an escalation in constraints on Palestinian civil society organisations.
